english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for persistently insisting on doing V despite obstacles.

examples.english: I will tenaciously insist on seeing them, no matter what happens.
examples.traditional: 我死都要去見佢，天塌落嚟都唔改。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sei2 dou1 jiu3 heoi3 gin3 keoi5 tin1 taap3 lok6 lai4 dou1 m4 goi2
